title: Outpatient Percutaneous Radiologic Gastrostomy in Patients With Head and Neck Tumors
brief_summary: This study intends to evaluate the security and success rate of large bore percutaneous radiologic gastrostomy in patients with head and neck tumors, as a outpatient procedure.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Surgical risk ASA I-III, Karnofsky Performance Status \>70, acceptance and comprehension of the orientations and after-care, adequate social a familiar support, easy access to the hospital.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who live more than one hour away from the hospital, coagulopathies, refuse to join the protocol.
